If sentiment is positive (≥0.67) in the last 3 days, reduce forecast by 0.5–1.5% for early horizon (1–7 days) to avoid over-optimism.

If sentiment is negative (≤0.33) in the last 3 days, increase forecast by 0.5–1.5% for mid horizon (8–15 days) to counteract pessimism bias.

If sentiment is neutral (0.33–0.67) and forecast peaks above 75.00, cap forecast at 75.00 for late horizon (16–30 days) to prevent overcorrection.

If sentiment swings from positive to negative within 3 days, reduce forecast slope by 10–20% for mid horizon to reflect sentiment reversal.

If sentiment is consistently positive over 5+ days, shift forecast downward by 0.5–1.0% per day for late horizon to reflect diminishing momentum.

If sentiment is consistently negative over 5+ days, shift forecast upward by 0.5–1.0% per day for early horizon to reflect potential reversal.
